title: Make lock screen player stylish
description: Redesign the lock screen media player with a polished, consistent Muslim Days visual style and clear playback controls.

title: Advanced custom event and screen-time tracking
description: Track users with a privacy-safe unique ID, custom Firebase and Google Analytics events, screen views, and time spent on each screen.

title: Add app reverse-engineering protection
description: Harden release builds against reverse engineering with code obfuscation, secret protection, integrity checks, and documented release verification.

title: Fix new Firebase crash
description: Investigate the latest Firebase crash report, reproduce the failing path, implement the fix, and verify it against affected app versions.

title: Fix Firebase Messaging notification bugs
description: Audit Firebase Messaging delivery and notification handling, reproduce current bugs, and verify foreground, background, and terminated-state behavior.

title: Build notification screen for hard-coded notifications
description: Create a dedicated in-app screen for viewing and managing hard-coded notifications with consistent navigation and presentation.

title: Add dedicated notification settings screen
description: Add a dedicated settings screen for notification preferences, categories, permissions, and user-controlled delivery behavior.

title: Improve Muslim Days AI
description: Improve the Muslim Days AI experience with more accurate responses, better Islamic context, clearer UX, stronger reliability, and measurable quality checks.

title: পাঁচ ওয়াক্ত নামাজের নিয়ত
description: ফজর, জোহর, আসর, মাগরিব ও এশার নামাজের নিয়ত নিয়ে সহজ, নির্ভুল বাংলা content প্রস্তুত করা; মুখে উচ্চারণ ও অন্তরের নিয়ত বিষয়ে নির্ভরযোগ্য ফিকহি ব্যাখ্যা ও source review অন্তর্ভুক্ত করা।

title: নামাজ ভঙ্গের কারণ ও নামাজের ফরজসমূহ
description: নামাজ ভঙ্গ হওয়ার কারণ এবং নামাজের ফরজগুলো পরিষ্কারভাবে সাজিয়ে content তৈরি করা; নির্ভরযোগ্য ফিকহি source ও scholarly review দিয়ে তথ্য যাচাই করা।

title: অজু ভঙ্গের কারণ ও অজুর ফরজসমূহ
description: অজু ভঙ্গের কারণ এবং অজুর ফরজগুলো সহজ ভাষায় সাজিয়ে content তৈরি করা; মতভেদ থাকলে তা চিহ্নিত করে নির্ভরযোগ্য ফিকহি source দিয়ে যাচাই করা।

title: নফল নামাজ: সালাতুত তাসবিহ বিষয়ে investigation
description: সালাতুত তাসবিহের হাদিস, আমলের নিয়ম, ফজিলত এবং হাদিসের গ্রহণযোগ্যতা নিয়ে আলেমদের মতভেদ নির্ভরযোগ্য primary ও scholarly source থেকে investigate করা; review ছাড়া publish না করা।

title: Fix relevant text on the alarm screen
description: Review and correct all relevant alarm-screen text, labels, instructions, localization, and empty or error-state copy so the screen is clear and consistent.

title: Improve calendar screen and show all month names
description: Make the calendar screen more visually polished and add an accessible place to view the names of all 12 Hijri months, all 12 Bangla months, and all 12 English months.

title: Add To-do as the fourth tool with a modern screen
description: Add To-do as item 4 inside Tools and create a modern, polished dedicated screen. Before implementation, investigate the existing Tools architecture, navigation and UX patterns, task data model, local persistence, and any sync or notification requirements.

title: Create full app features and services documentation page
description: Create a well-organized HTML documentation page covering every Muslim Days app feature, screen, user flow, architecture, and dependency. Document all services in use, including Firebase, Cloudflare, and Google Analytics, and add a verified inventory of every open-source API with its name, purpose, endpoint or source link, license, data usage, owner, and where it is used in the app.

title: Add flexible location-based Sehri, Iftar, Azan and prayer times
description: Add a clear home-page settings flow where users can adjust Sehri, Iftar, and all five daily prayer times for their own area. Keep Azan time and congregation or personal prayer time as two separate values for every prayer, so a user can choose when the Azan should play and when they plan to pray. Validate time format, ordering, duplicates, date and timezone changes, and invalid gaps; show the selected area and whether each value is calculated or manually overridden. Apply the saved times consistently to the home page, countdowns, alarms, reminders, notifications, widgets, and lock-screen surfaces. Support per-prayer enable or disable controls, a safe reset to the calculated location-based schedule, and a clear fallback when location or prayer-time data is unavailable. Preserve manual choices across app restarts and document how daylight-saving, travel, and location changes affect overrides. Acceptance criteria: each time can be edited independently; Azan and prayer times never overwrite one another; invalid entries cannot be saved and explain the error; all affected UI and notifications use the chosen values; and reset restores the current area's verified default schedule.

title: Add small horizontal dividers to prayer-time sections
description: On the prayer-times screen, add a small horizontal divider in each of these three sections: prohibited prayer times, morning Nafl Salah, and night Nafl Ibadah. Use the same divider width, thickness, color, alignment, and vertical spacing in all three places; match the existing visual system and keep it clear in light and dark themes. Acceptance criteria: all three dividers render in the correct section, remain aligned on supported screen sizes, do not overlap or shift nearby text, and use accessible contrast without becoming visually dominant.

title: Build a reliable Zakat calculator
description: Design and build a clear Zakat calculator for eligible cash, bank balances, gold, silver, investments, business assets, receivables, and deductible short-term liabilities. Support gold- or silver-based Nisab, current metal prices with source and last-updated time, local currency conversion, manual price override, Hijri-year eligibility, and the standard 2.5% calculation with an itemized result. Investigate and document recognized scholarly differences before implementation, explain what is included or excluded, cite reviewed Islamic sources, and avoid presenting disputed rules as universal. Keep financial inputs private on the device and provide reset, save or resume, share or export, accessibility, input validation, and offline fallback behavior. Acceptance criteria: the user can select a Nisab method, enter assets and eligible liabilities, see whether the threshold is met, understand every calculation step, identify the price and source used, and receive a clearly labeled estimate with a recommendation to consult a qualified scholar for personal cases.

title: Build a Durood reminder
description: Investigate and design an optional Durood reminder with user-selected schedule, frequency, quiet hours, notification controls, completion tracking, and respectful copy. Verify the Arabic text, transliteration, translation, virtues, references, and any suggested counts with qualified scholarly review before implementation.

title: Build an Istighfar reminder
description: Investigate and design an optional Istighfar reminder with flexible schedule, frequency, quiet hours, notification controls, completion tracking, and respectful copy. Verify the Arabic text, transliteration, translation, references, virtues, and any suggested counts with qualified scholarly review before implementation.

title: Automatically silence the phone during prayer times
description: Investigate an opt-in feature that automatically enables silent or Do Not Disturb mode during selected prayer windows and restores the previous sound state afterward. Review Android and iOS platform restrictions, permissions, exact Azan-versus-prayer-time triggers, per-prayer duration, manual overrides, emergency contacts, overlapping schedules, reboot behavior, battery optimization, privacy, and safe failure recovery.

title: Add a curated list of 20 custom Duas
description: Research and add a curated list of 20 useful Duas with Arabic text, Bangla and English translation, transliteration, source reference, context, authenticity status, category, favorites, search, sharing, and offline access. Define whether custom means an editorial collection or user-created entries, and complete Arabic proofreading plus qualified Islamic review before publishing.

title: Build Umrah and Hajj trackers
description: Investigate and design separate guided trackers for Umrah and Hajj, covering preparation, Ihram, Miqat, Tawaf, Sa'i, Halq or Taqsir, Mina, Arafat, Muzdalifah, Jamarat, sacrifice, progress, checklists, Duas, reminders, offline use, and accessible step-by-step guidance. Account for different Hajj types and recognized scholarly differences, verify the ritual order and content with qualified reviewers, and clearly distinguish required, obligatory, recommended, and optional actions.

title: Add Eid prayer rules and Duas
description: Research and create a clear Eid prayer guide covering preparation, timing, number of Rak'ahs, extra Takbirs, congregation flow, Khutbah, missed-prayer cases, recommended acts, and relevant Duas or Takbir. Identify recognized Madhhab differences instead of presenting one method as universal; verify Arabic text, transliteration, Bangla and English meaning, Hadith references, and authenticity with qualified scholarly review before publishing. Present Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha differences where applicable, with accessible step-by-step content and source citations.

title: Add Janazah prayer rules and Duas
description: Research and create a respectful step-by-step Janazah prayer guide covering prerequisites, intention, standing position, four Takbirs, recitations, Salam, congregation arrangement, and relevant Duas for adults and children. Document recognized Madhhab differences, exceptional cases, and guidance for those who miss part of the prayer; verify every Arabic text, transliteration, Bangla and English meaning, Hadith reference, and authenticity with qualified scholarly review before publishing. Use sensitive, accessible language and include clear source citations.

title: Add a verified Ruqyah recitation list and count tracker
description: Investigate and create a Ruqyah list showing the verified Qur'anic Surahs and Ayahs, the supported recitation count where an authentic source specifies one, and a simple tracker for how many times each item has been read. Do not invent or imply fixed counts when reliable evidence does not specify them; label scholarly differences and source strength clearly. Include Arabic text, Bangla and English meaning, reference, completion state, reset, session history, offline access, and qualified Qur'an, Hadith, and scholarly review before publishing.

title: Add verified Ruqyah Duas with pronunciation and audio
description: Research and add a curated set of authentic Ruqyah Duas with fully proofread Arabic, Bangla pronunciation, Bangla and English meaning, source reference, authenticity status, usage context, and high-quality recitation audio. Investigate narrator or reciter selection, audio rights and license, download and offline playback, play or pause and seek controls, speed, accessibility, and text-audio matching. Require qualified Arabic, Hadith, and scholarly review, and clearly separate established Ruqyah from unsupported practices before publishing.

title: Add the Dua for protection from harmful wind
description: Add the authentic Dua for seeking protection from the harm of wind, with proofread Arabic text, Bangla pronunciation, Bangla and English meaning, Hadith source and authenticity note, usage context, favorites, sharing, and offline access. Verify the wording and reference with qualified Arabic and Hadith review before publishing, and present it respectfully without unsupported claims.

title: Build a Qaza prayer reminder
description: Deeply investigate and design an optional Qaza prayer reminder without making unsupported assumptions about a user's religious obligations. Review recognized scholarly positions and Madhhab differences on missed prayers, order, intention, prohibited times, menstruation-related exclusions, travel, and record keeping with qualified scholars before implementation. Define a privacy-first flow where users manually add or estimate missed prayers, choose a manageable plan and reminder schedule, mark completion, correct mistakes, pause reminders, and keep all sensitive history on-device by default. Use compassionate language, avoid guilt-inducing notifications, distinguish estimates from confirmed records, and publish only reviewed guidance with clear sources and limitations.

title: Add Abdul Rahman Al-Sudais as default reciter and expand the reciter library
description: Set Sheikh Abdul Rahman Al-Sudais as the default Qur'an reciter and investigate a large catalog of additional recitations that can legally be streamed or downloaded. Build a verified reciter manifest containing reciter name, riwayah, Surah and Ayah coverage, audio quality, source URL, license or explicit usage permission, attribution requirements, file format, size, checksum, and availability. Design reciter search and selection, per-Surah playback, seamless verse transitions, download management, offline playback, caching, resume position, fallback when a source fails, and migration for existing users. Do not include audio until its rights and integrity are verified; confirm the default-reciter audio source, redistribution terms, API reliability, and ongoing hosting cost before implementation.

title: Add adjustable Sehri and Iftar time offsets
description: Extend the custom prayer-time work in MD-017 with independent plus or minus minute offsets for Sehri and Iftar, because verified local schedules can differ by area. Investigate whether an offset should remain relative to each newly calculated daily time or freeze the manually displayed clock time; prefer a clearly labeled relative offset when the base schedule changes, while preserving an explicit fixed-time option only if research supports it. Show base time, adjustment, final time, calculation method, location, and last update; validate safe ranges and prevent confusing date crossover. Apply the final values consistently to the home page, Ramadan calendar, countdowns, alarms, widgets, and notifications, with reset-to-default and a migration rule when location, timezone, calculation method, date, or remote schedule changes.

title: Design an Ayyam al-Bid fasting notification screen
description: Design a dedicated notification screen for Ayyam al-Bid fasting on the 13th, 14th, and 15th of each Hijri month, delivered through Firebase. Investigate Hijri-date calculation versus local moon-sighting adjustments, scheduling timezone, notification consent, Android full-screen intent eligibility, iOS platform limitations, foreground, background, and terminated app behavior, OEM restrictions, and a standard notification or deep-link fallback when automatic full-screen display is not permitted. The screen should explain the fasting days, show the verified local dates and source, allow remind-later and dismiss actions, respect quiet hours and opt-out settings, avoid duplicate delivery, work after reboot or timezone changes, and record delivery analytics without collecting sensitive personal data.

title: Build a private daily Amal Tracker
description: Design and build a private, encouraging Amal Tracker organized by date. Provide separate trackable items for the five Fard prayers; Nafl prayers including Ishraq and Chasht or Duha; Tahajjud; Qur'an recitation with an option to record reading with Bangla meaning; protection Duas; morning Adhkar and Duas; evening Adhkar and Duas; self-improvement; Nafl fasting; Sadaqah; physical exercise; and reading Islamic books. Let users enable only the habits they want, add personal goals or notes, mark partial or complete progress, set flexible daily or weekly targets and reminders, and review calendar, streak, summary, and trend views. Keep worship history private on-device by default with secure backup or export only through explicit consent; support offline use, correction, reset, missed-day handling, and accessible Bangla and English UI. Avoid competitive, guilt-inducing, or public ranking patterns. Investigate and verify the names, timing, counts, virtues, Arabic text, translations, and sources of every included Salah, Dua, Adhkar, and fasting practice with qualified scholarly review before publishing. Acceptance criteria: every category can be independently enabled, scheduled, completed, edited, and reviewed by date; Fard and Nafl items are clearly separated; Qur'an reading can record Arabic-only or Bangla-meaning progress; reminders respect quiet hours; and all summaries accurately reflect the user's selected goals and entries.

title: Show nearby mosques on an interactive map
description: Add a Nearby Mosques feature that opens an interactive map centered on the user's current location and shows nearby mosque markers. Support list and map views, distance and estimated travel time, mosque name and address, open-in-maps directions, search radius, manual location search, recenter, loading, empty, permission-denied, offline, and location-unavailable states. Investigate a reliable map and places data source, API terms, open-source options such as OpenStreetMap-based services, attribution, rate limits, result accuracy, duplicate or closed places, operating cost, caching, and Android and iOS permission requirements before implementation. Request precise location only when needed, explain its use, avoid retaining location history, and provide an approximate-location fallback. Acceptance criteria: users can find and select a nearby mosque, open directions in their preferred maps app, change the search area, and use the feature safely when location permission or network access is unavailable.

title: Design native home-screen widgets from the app
description: Design and build native Android and iOS home-screen widgets that use the Muslim Days app's visual language, colors, typography, icons, and data. Define useful small, medium, and large layouts for the next prayer and countdown, today's prayer times, Hijri and Gregorian date, Sehri and Iftar during Ramadan, location, and a tap action that opens the relevant app screen. Let users select the widget content and theme while keeping information readable in light, dark, dynamic-color, and accessibility modes. Investigate platform widget frameworks, minimum sizes, update-frequency and background-execution limits, battery use, timezone and location changes, custom prayer-time offsets, stale-data handling, offline fallback, app-to-widget data sharing, and behavior after reboot or app updates. Acceptance criteria: each supported widget renders consistently with the app, displays the same verified times as the app, refreshes at safe prayer and date boundaries, exposes a last-updated or stale state when needed, and opens the correct destination when tapped.
